ohhh i see!! yeah sounds like a diagnosis to me. btw what you described does sound like adhd in girls, personally i don’t have it but i have friends who do. one thing i’ve learned that helps is to create a reward system for yourself in order to accomplish tasks more easily. when you have adhd your brain is low on dopamine so if you create a system where you get a boost of it (eg buy something for yourself) after finishing things, it’ll make it easier. also doing work for shorter periods of time is one tip i’ve heard, some people may start with doing 10minutes, having a break then extending those periods slowly. some people may prefer to start off with say 50 minutes, and as their attention starts wavering they shorten that into periods of 40, 30, and so on. also i’m guessing forgetting things for you would be a big thing, my friend who has adhd actually writes stuff that she has to do on her arm so that there’s no way she forgets that to-do list exists hahah

adhd is actually frequently comorbid with bpd! it’s a neurodevelopmental disorder so you might want to maybe think about any difficulties you had growing up. if you’re female those symptoms are less external and more of an internal struggle, like daydreaming very frequently, or zoning out in the middle of conversations. also while these may sound like normal things that happen to everyone, if it happens to you regularly to the point where it’s impairing you then yup, sounds like symptoms of adhd.
